title: Lead/Senior SQA Analyst
description:
**Job Description:**

**Our Mission:**

We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high-value content.

**About Us:**

Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high-value content - technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.

Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.

**Position Summary:**

Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

**Quality Ownership & Technical Leadership**

* Own end-to-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.

**Test Strategy & Coverage**

* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG & EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.

**Automation & CI/CD Excellence**

* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.

**Functional & Workflow Testing**

* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.

**XML and Publishing Validation**

* Perform validation of XML-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.

**Data Layer Testing**

* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.

**API and Integration Testing**

* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook-based integrations and event-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system-to-system communication.
* Perform end-to-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.

**Performance and Reliability Testing**

* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.

**Collaboration & Execution**

* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.

**Experience and Skills:**

**Mandatory Requirements & Qualifications**:

* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.
* Hands-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts.
* Experience testing modern APIs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven, and webhook-based workflows.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.
* Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Minimum of 10 years' experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. .
* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision.
* Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level.
* Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience.
* Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Education: MCA / Bachelor's in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent).
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Skills & Qualifications:**

* Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation.
* Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL).
* Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG & EAA compliance).
* Proficiency with Git and version control systems.
* Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms.
* Exposure to cloud-based testing environments (AWS/Azure).
* Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for test execution.
* Knowledge of security testing fundamentals (OWASP).

title: IBM Sterling OMS Senior Engineer
description:
Job ID

70504

Category

Enterprise Technology

Location

Chennai, India

Work Type

On-site

Ford Motor Company is looking for a Senior Engineer with deep, **hands-on, day-to-day** technical expertise in IBM Sterling Order Management System (OMS) to join our Order Management engineering organization in Chennai. This is a strong hands-on engineering role—the candidate will be personally writing code, configuring the platform, building microservices, and debugging production issues. The role is suited for an experienced practitioner who thrives in configuring, customizing, and extending Sterling OMS, Order Hub, and Next Gen Call Center within complex enterprise ecosystems, while demonstrating strong engineering fundamentals, clean and maintainable code, disciplined unit testing, and a high bar for secure and compliant software delivery.

As a Senior IBM OMS Engineer, you will play a key hands-on role in designing, developing, and modernizing order management capabilities that support Ford's end-to-end commerce, order orchestration, and fulfillment journeys. You will work extensively and directly within the IBM Sterling OMS platform—including Order Hub and Next Gen Call Center modules—configuring business rules, writing custom APIs and services, extending workflows, and integrating Sterling with upstream and downstream enterprise systems. You will also build and deploy microservices using strong Java skills, packaged and run in containerized, cloud-native environments (GCP or equivalent). Your work will directly contribute to building reliable, scalable, and highly available order management capabilities that meet demanding performance and operational expectations.

This role requires a "product-mindset," technically hands-on engineer with strong command of Sterling OMS internals—order lifecycle, transaction management, agent/service framework, and integration patterns—as well as modern cloud and microservices engineering practices. You will partner with cross-functional teams (product, architecture, QA, and other engineering squads) to translate business requirements into well-structured, personally-built technical solutions within the Sterling platform. You must design and build software that aligns with enterprise standards for reliability, security, and cloud-native maintainability.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, outcome-driven, and able to navigate ambiguity—an engineer who codes and configures daily, digs deep into complex order management issues, proposes pragmatic solutions, and raises the overall quality bar through direct technical contributions, code reviews, and mentorship.

**What You'll Do**

* **OMS Platform Engineering:** Design, develop, configure, and maintain IBM Sterling OMS solutions, including distributed order management, reverse logistics, payments, inventory, order hub, call center etc.
* **Customization & Extension:** Build and extend Sterling OMS using Java-based customizations—user exits, agents, event handlers, custom APIs, and transaction extensions—to meet evolving business requirements.
* **Order Orchestration:** Configure and optimize order lifecycle flows, sourcing rules, release management, and fulfillment logic to ensure seamless end-to-end order processing.
* **Integration:** Design and build robust integrations between Sterling OMS and enterprise systems (ERP, POS, inventory, payment, and shipping platforms) using RESTful/SOAP APIs, JMS, and asynchronous messaging patterns.
* **Database Management:** Work with SQL databases to design efficient schemas, tune Sterling OMS data models, and optimize query and transaction performance.
* **Troubleshooting:** Perform deep troubleshooting and root cause analysis across Sterling OMS configurations, customizations, and integrations; drive fixes that address underlying architectural issues rather than symptoms.
* **Engineering Best Practices:** Uphold and advocate for:
  + Clean architecture, modular customizations, and readable code.
  + Comprehensive automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end).
  + Peer reviews and shared coding standards.
  + Secure coding practices and compliance with organizational security/dependency scanning.
* **Mentorship:** Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and guidance on Sterling OMS best practices and modern Java development.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 8+ years of **strong, hands-on** experience with IBM Sterling Order Management System (OMS) in enterprise environments, including implementation, configuration, and customization.
* Hands-on experience with customizing **Order Hub** and/ or **Next Gen Call Center** modules within the Sterling OMS ecosystem.
* Strong, hands-on Java development skills, with proven experience customizing Sterling OMS using its extension framework (user exits, agents, event handlers, custom APIs).
* Practical experience designing, building, and deploying **microservices**.
* Hands-on experience with **cloud platforms (GCP or equivalent, e.g., Azure/AWS)** and **containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)**.
* Deep understanding of Sterling OMS architecture: order lifecycle, transaction/agent framework, rule engine, sourcing, and inventory management.
* Strong experience with RESTful/SOAP APIs, XML/JSON, and asynchronous integration patterns (e.g., JMS, Kafka, or MQ) for connecting Sterling OMS to enterprise systems.
* Solid experience with SQL databases, including schema design and query/transaction performance optimization.
* Strong understanding of cloud native design patterns, and data structures.
* Demonstrated commitment to code quality with testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across global teams.
* Experience with e-commerce, retail, or automotive order fulfillment domains.
* Familiarity with modern engineering productivity tooling and/or AI-assisted development concepts.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Exposure to front-end technologies (React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript) for building supporting UI components or dashboards.
* Familiarity with modern engineering productivity tooling and/or AI-assisted development concepts.
* Experience working on OpenShift Container Platform
* Automation frameworks like selenium and playwright

Job Description: Configurator Specialist

**The Opportunity**
===================

As a Configurator Specialist, you will be responsible for the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of product configurators supporting Configure-to-Order (CTO) and Engineer-to-Order (ETO) processes. You will ensure accurate product configurations, seamless integration with pricing and costing, and effective support for sales and engineering teams while adhering to established governance frameworks.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

Design, develop, and maintain product configurator models aligned with business requirements.

Ensure accuracy of configuration logic, rules, dependencies, and constraints.

Maintain configuration-related master data including product structures, attributes, pricing, and costing inputs.

Ensure data consistency between configurators and integrated systems such as SAP and CPQ platforms.

Perform comprehensive testing of configuration scenarios and support SIT and UAT activities.

Collaborate with engineering, product management, sales, and IT teams to translate business requirements into configuration logic.

Provide operational support by troubleshooting and resolving configuration-related issues.

Coordinate with AMS and IT teams for defect resolution and system improvements.

Identify opportunities for configurator optimization and continuous improvement.

Ensure adherence to governance standards, data quality guidelines, and compliance requirements.

**Your Background**
===================

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

Minimum 8+ years of experience in product configuration, CPQ systems, or related domains, preferably in transformers or manufacturing industries.

Strong experience in Configure-to-Order (CTO) and/or Engineer-to-Order (ETO) environments.

Knowledge of product structures (BOMs), configuration logic, and variant management.

Hands-on experience with CPQ platforms (e.g., Conga, Salesforce CPQ) and SAP SD/MM integration.

Understanding of pricing and costing concepts related to configuration.

Experience supporting testing cycles (SIT/UAT) and Agile methodologies is preferred.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Effective communication and collaboration skills across cross-functional teams.

Proficiency in written and spoken English.

**Core Competencies**

Configuration development and maintenance

Cross-functional collaboration

Data accuracy and quality management

Problem solving and analytical thinking

Continuous improvement mindset

title: Service Engineer – IT
description:
**Department:** IT / Technology  
**Location:** Adambakkam  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Reporting To:** IT Manager / IT Head

About the Role

We are looking for a **Service Engineer – IT** to provide day-to-day technical support and ensure the smooth functioning of the organisation's IT systems and infrastructure. The role will be responsible for troubleshooting hardware and software issues, supporting users, maintaining IT assets, assisting with network and connectivity requirements, and ensuring timely resolution of IT-related requests.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical troubleshooting skills, a service-oriented approach, and the ability to manage multiple IT support requirements effectively.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide first-level and second-level IT support to employees and resolve day-to-day technical issues.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, operating system, network, and system-related issues.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT peripherals.
* Set up and manage user accounts, access rights, email accounts, and system permissions.
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, internet, and other connectivity-related issues.
* Provide technical support for Microsoft Windows, Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, and other business applications.
* Monitor and maintain IT systems and infrastructure to ensure availability and smooth operation.
* Perform software installations, system updates, security patches, and preventive maintenance.
* Maintain accurate records of IT assets, equipment allocation, and inventory.
* Coordinate with external IT vendors and service providers for technical support and maintenance when required.
* Record, track, and resolve IT support requests through the designated ticketing or service management system.
* Assist with data backup, antivirus, endpoint security, and other basic IT security activities.
* Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including account setup, access management, and IT asset allocation or recovery.
* Maintain documentation relating to IT configurations, procedures, troubleshooting, and support activities.
* Assist with the implementation and adherence to IT policies, procedures, and security controls.
* Provide remote and on-site technical support as required.
* Identify recurring technical issues and assist in implementing appropriate solutions.
* Perform other IT-related duties and responsibilities assigned by management.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant technical certifications will be an advantage.
* Strong practical knowledge of IT hardware, software, operating systems, and basic networking.

Required Experience

* **2–4 years of relevant experience** in IT technical support, service desk, desktop support, or a similar role.
* Hands-on experience in hardware and software troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting Windows and Microsoft 365 environments.
* Practical knowledge of network and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience in IT asset management and user support.
* Experience handling IT support requests and resolving issues within defined timelines.

Technical Skills

* Microsoft Windows operating systems
* Microsoft 365
* Microsoft Outlook and Teams
* Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID
* LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP
* Wi-Fi and VPN troubleshooting
* Desktop, laptop, printer, and peripheral troubleshooting
* Antivirus and endpoint security
* Remote desktop and remote support tools
* IT ticketing / service management systems
* Basic data backup and recovery concepts
* Basic understanding of IT security practices

Soft Skills

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
* Good verbal and written communication skills
* Customer-service-oriented approach
* Ability to prioritise and manage multiple support requests
* Strong attention to detail
* Good time management and organisational skills
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Professional and courteous approach when dealing with users

Preferred / Additional Skills

* Microsoft certifications
* CompTIA A+ or CompTIA Network+
* ITIL certification or knowledge
* Exposure to cloud platforms and services
* Experience with endpoint management tools
* Basic knowledge of cybersecurity tools and practices
* Experience with IT asset management systems

Key Competencies

* Technical Troubleshooting
* IT Service Management
* Problem Solving
* User Support
* Communication
* Time Management
* Documentation
* IT Asset Management
* Team Collaboration
* Customer Service

Role Expectations

The Service Engineer – IT is expected to provide timely and effective technical support, maintain a reliable IT environment, follow established IT procedures and security practices, and ensure a positive support experience for employees. title: Senior Security Architect
description:
Overview:

Expleo is a trusted partner for end\-to\-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.
As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.
As **Senior Security Architect**, you will be the senior technical adviser within the offshore consultancy team. Working under the technical direction of the UK Head of Service, who holds design authority, you will produce the security architecture, design and risk material that underpins the service, and provide technical leadership to the offshore engineers.**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK\-based, security\-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.
Responsibilities:
**Responsibilities*** Produce and maintain security architecture and design documentation (high\-level and low\-level designs) for the client's security tooling estate, for approval by the UK Head of Service.
* Carry out architecture and risk reviews of proposed high\-risk changes (firewall, intrusion prevention, gateway, privileged access and application control) before they are presented to the client's Change Advisory Board.
* Define logging and audit requirements for in\-scope security tools, including log sources, feed requirements for the client's retained SIEM, and a retention architecture aligned with client policy and regulatory obligations.
* Assess and recommend tooling and approaches for PKI and secrets management.
* Produce NIS Regulations and NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) alignment assessments and contribute evidence to the client's regulatory reporting.
* Prepare inputs for the client's governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) reporting on the enterprise's security status.
* Develop risk treatment plans in line with client policy and industry best practice and maintain inputs to the security risk register.
* Prepare technical content and risk papers for the client's cyber security governance board, in support of the UK Head of Service and the Lead Information Risk Manager.
* Maintain the master set of security architecture diagrams and ensure that diagrams produced by the engineering team are consistent and up to date.
* Identify and assess continual improvement opportunities, including benefit\-cost appraisal and sequencing into quick wins, foundational change and strategic uplift.
* Apply appropriate consideration of operational technology (OT) and IT/OT boundary risk in all architecture and design work.
* Provide technical leadership, peer review and mentoring to the Lead Security Engineer, Security Engineers and Vulnerability and Patch Manager.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing, technical contribution and client\-facing delivery excellence.


Qualifications:
* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* CISSP, CISSP\-ISSAP or SABSA Chartered Foundation (at least one required).
* TOGAF, a cloud security certification (e.g. CCSP, AZ\-500, AWS Security Specialty) or GICSP/ISA/IEC 62443 certification would be advantageous.


Essential skills:
* Enterprise security architecture across network, identity, endpoint, cloud and data security domains.
* Designing logging and SIEM integration architectures, including log source definition and retention requirements.
* Applying risk assessment methods such as ISO/IEC 27005 and NIST SP 800\-30\.
* Working knowledge of the NIS Regulations, NCSC CAF, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF and CIS Controls.
* Reviewing proposed changes for architectural and security risk, and producing clear, evidence\-based recommendations.
* Excellent written communication for executive, governance and regulator\-facing documentation.


Ability to lead and quality\-assure the work of other engineers
Desired skills:
* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Knowledge of OT/ICS security concepts, the Purdue model and IEC 62443\.
* Experience with GRC tooling (e.g. ServiceNow IRM, Archer).
* Experience with Ofgem or NIS\-regulated cyber assurance activity.


Experience:
* 12\+ years in IT and cybersecurity, including 6\+ years in security architecture for enterprise or CNI environments.
* Experience producing architecture, design and risk artefacts for regulated organisations.
* Experience supporting governance boards, risk registers and GRC reporting.
* Experience working with multi\-supplier environments and managed security service providers.


What do I need before I apply:
* Have the right to work in India.
* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.
* Be willing to complete Expleo enhanced pre\-employment background screening *(equivalent in standard to the UK Baseline Personnel Security Standard)* and any additional vetting the client requires.
* Be able to work hours that overlap with the UK business day, with occasional out\-of\-hours advisory support during major incidents.
* Have excellent written and spoken English, suitable for engagement with senior UK stakeholders.
* Be comfortable working within a strict security boundary, with no access to the client's operational systems or data.


Benefits:
* Collaborative working environment: we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges.
* We empower all passionate, technology\-loving professionals to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects.
* Expleo Academy enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses.
* Competitive local company benefits *\[India HR to confirm the benefits package].*
* Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo.


“We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.”
If you are an experienced Security Architect with a strong background in enterprise and CNI security architecture, and you enjoy shaping how critical services are secured, we encourage you to apply today.

title: Data Integration Senior Analyst
description:
At ZeroNorth, we are at the forefront of transforming the shipping industry through digital innovation. Our solutions go beyond optimising business operations, they are designed to lead the industry in sustainability by significantly reducing CO2 emissions.


Our core mission of making global trade greener drives everything we do. Your contributions will play a crucial role in reducing emissions, aligning commercial success with sustainability, and delivering benefits for both profitability and the environment.


ZeroNorth is powered by a diverse team of 550\+ professionals with more than 38 nationalities, operating out of global hubs including Copenhagen (our headquarters), Athens, Chennai, Mumbai, Singapore, Sofia, and Tokyo.


We are leading the industry's green transition, enabling our partners to leverage data for actionable decarbonisation efforts.

**Data Integration Senior Analyst at ZeroNorth**


This role sits at the intersection of customer onboarding, technical integration delivery, and cross\-functional coordination. You are the primary point of contact for IMOS integrations and Voyage Management System integrations — owning delivery from implementation through to production stability across a portfolio of 20\-30 customers.


You work daily with the Vessel Reporting Onboarding team, Tech teams, Customer Success, and customers directly. When an integration fails, you diagnose it, resolve it, and document what happened so the same problem doesn't repeat. When a new customer onboards, you own the technical thread end to end. When something is broken at a systemic level, you surface it with evidence and push for a fix.


This is not a ticket\-handler role. It requires someone who understands how data moves through a maritime SaaS platform, can read an error log, and knows the difference between a mapping issue and an engineering defect.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Own end\-to\-end delivery on IMOS and Voyage integrations — onboarding, error monitoring, escalation, and production stability.
* Act as the primary internal SME for integration queries from Support, Onboarding, and Customer Success.
* Triage failed reports, identify root cause, and resolve or escalate to Engineering with full context and reproduction steps.
* Scope, groom, and guide engineers on current and upcoming development work.
* Document customer mappings, error\-handling processes, and onboarding runbooks in Notion; keep them current.
* Identify recurring issues across customers, document root cause, and escalate structured findings to Product and Engineering rather than solving the same problem case by case.
* Write and maintain integration runbooks, process documentation, and troubleshooting guides so knowledge is never locked in one person's head.

**Your profile:**

* 3\+ years in a technical onboarding, integration, or customer\-facing role in B2B SaaS. Maritime experience (fleet operations, ship management, IMOS, Veslink) is a strong advantage.
* Able to read integration logs, understand how a data pipeline works, diagnose where it breaks, and explain the fix clearly to a non\-technical customer.
* Familiar with mapping concepts — voyage numbers, port codes, vessel identifiers — and comfortable picking up new data schemas quickly.
* Organised under pressure: you can hold 10\+ active customer threads simultaneously and know which one needs your attention first.
* A pattern\-spotter. The ideal candidate has a track record of noticing the same problem recurring across customers and doing something about it — a documented root cause, a process change, a structured escalation — rather than solving each case in isolation.
* Comfortable working directly with engineers: you can read a ticket in Linear, understand what the engineer is building, and flag when an implementation choice is wrong for customers.
* Fluent written and spoken English. A second language (particularly relevant to the maritime sector) is a plus.
* Technical Skills \- Experience with API, SQL, Snowflake, JSON is ideal

**About ZeroNorth**


At ZeroNorth, we aim to make global trade sustainable by steering the maritime industry toward zero emissions. Using advanced technology and trusted data, our platform delivers real\-time insights to optimize operations and align commercial success with environmental impact.


We partner with customers on their journey toward sustainability, solving complex challenges and empowering informed decisions that benefit both the planet and their bottom line.


Our culture thrives on growth, inclusion, and collaboration. We value honesty, trust, and the unique contributions of every team member, driving meaningful change together.


Let's make global trade green.

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Engineer in QA to spearhead our API automation efforts. This role is critical in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our microservices\-based platform built with Spring Boot and deployed on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The ideal candidate will have a strong background in API automation using RestAssured/Karate and BDD frameworks and a deep understanding of cloud\-native technologies.


* **Leadership and Strategy:**
	+ Develop and execute a comprehensive API automation strategy aligned with the overall quality goals of the organization.
	+ Identify and implement innovative testing approaches and technologies to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our QA processes.
* **API Automation Development:**
	+ Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable API automation frameworks using RestAssured and BDD principles.
	+ Write clean, well\-documented, and maintainable automation scripts to validate API functionality, performance, and security.
	+ Implement data\-driven testing strategies to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
	+ Integrate automation scripts into the CI/CD pipeline for continuous testing.
* **Collaboration and Communication:**
	+ Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure testability.
	+ Participate in design and architecture reviews to provide feedback on testability and identify potential quality risks.
	+ Communicate test results and quality metrics to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
	+ Work with extended integration partner teams to define and execute exploratory and automated API tests
* **Quality Assurance and Best Practices:**
	+ Establish and enforce QA guidelines, best practices, and standards across the team.
	+ Actively review code to ensure software quality and functional accuracy.
	+ Ensure all code adheres to secure coding practices and meets minimum code coverage requirements.
	+ Stay up\-to\-date with the latest trends and technologies in API automation and cloud\-native testing.
	+ Promote a culture of quality ownership and accountability within the team.
* **Operational Support:**
	+ Handle operational issues with minimal oversight, troubleshooting and resolving problems quickly and effectively.
	+ Build reusable frameworks and integrate SaaS frameworks to improve efficiency and scalability.
* **Experience:**10\+ years of experience in software development and quality assurance, with a strong focus on API automation.
* **Technical Expertise:**
	+ **API Automation:**
		- Extensive experience with RestAssured for API testing.
		- Proficiency in Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) frameworks like Cucumber/Gherkin.
		- Experience with API testing tools such as Hoppscotch, Postman, Swagger, or ReadyAPI.
		- Knowledge of API security testing principles and tools (e.g., OWASP).
	+ **Java and Spring Boot:**
		- Strong proficiency in Java and related open\-source technologies.
		- Hands\-on experience with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud frameworks for building microservices.
		- Experience with dependency injection, RESTful APIs, and other core Spring concepts.
	+ **Cloud Technologies:**
		- Solid understanding of cloud\-native technologies and architectures.
		- Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
		- Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services (e.g., Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions).
	+ **Testing Frameworks and Tools:**
		- Experience with unit testing frameworks like JUnit and TestNG.
		- Proficiency in using IDEs such as Eclipse or IntelliJ IDEA.
		- Experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI.
	+ **Databases:**
		- Basic knowledge of relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL datastores (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra).
		- Experience with data quality testing and working with large datasets.
	+ **Version Control and Collaboration:**
		- Proficiency in using version control systems like Git.
		- Experience with collaborative tools like GitHub, Bitbucket, or GitLab.
	+ **Other Technologies (Nice to Have):**
		- Knowledge of contract testing using Pact or similar frameworks.
		- Exposure to performance testing tools like JMeter or Gatling.
		- Experience with monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK stack.
* **Agile Development:**
	+ Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
	+ Experience working in Agile teams and participating in sprint ceremonies.
* **Soft Skills:**
	+ Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills.
	+ Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities.
	+ Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Keen to learn the design and architecture of the product and participate in ceremonies that can influence both.

Step into a workplace that blends competitive health benefits with true flexibility, including flex time and an annual work\-from\-anywhere policy. Take ownership of your future with our Employee Options Program, and enjoy the little things, like daily snacks, a vibrant cafeteria, and catered Friday lunches at our offices. **About Corpay Cross\-Border**
------------------------------


Corpay Cross\-Border helps businesses move money globally, manage currency risk, and streamline international payments. Our technology supports customers operating across markets, currencies, and regulatory environments, where reliability, security, and scale matter every day.


As part of Corpay, Inc. (NYSE: CPAY), a global corporate payments company, we combine the pace of a product\-led technology team with the reach and stability of a global financial services business. To learn more, visit Payments.corpay.com/cross\-border.

**How We Work**
---------------


As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:

* Assigned workspace in our Chennai office
* Company\-issued equipment
* Formal, hands\-on training

**Role Overview**
-----------------


As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay Cross\-Border, you will support the technical onboarding and implementation of clients integrating with Corpay's digital payment and FX solutions.


The role will primarily support clients and internal stakeholders across North America, with working hours aligned to the US Eastern Time (ET) timezone, while also providing technical support to client implementations and initiatives across other global regions as required.


You will work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and other Payment Solutions teams to support clients across integration modalities including REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other digital payment capabilities. The role requires strong technical aptitude, analytical problem\-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


In addition to client implementations, Solutions Engineering is regularly relied upon to support special projects, new product initiatives and ad\-hoc business requirements. The successful candidate should therefore be comfortable working across a variety of technical challenges and adapting to evolving business priorities.


The position will be primarily remote; however, the successful candidate will initially attend the Chennai office for induction and training and will be expected to attend occasionally thereafter for team meetings, training and other business requirements.

**Role Responsibilities**
-------------------------


The responsibilities of the role will include:

**Client Implementation \& Solutioning**
----------------------------------------

* Support end\-to\-end technical implementation activities from onboarding through testing, certification and Production go\-live.
* Support clients integrating through Corpay's REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other supported integration modalities.

**Technical Analysis \& Troubleshooting**
-----------------------------------------

* Investigate integration, configuration and implementation issues using appropriate diagnostic tools and available system information.

* Clearly document technical findings, troubleshooting steps and recommended solutions.
* Contribute to testing and validation of new or enhanced product capabilities where Solutions Engineering support is required.

**Global Team \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
--------------------------------------------

* Work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and the Solutions Engineering Lead to support successful client delivery across North America and, where required, other global regions.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across different geographies and time zones.
* Share lessons learned, technical knowledge and implementation best practices with the wider Solutions Engineering team.
* Contribute to team documentation, implementation standards and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* Maintain effective communication with North American stakeholders while remaining connected to the wider Chennai and global Payment Solutions organisation.

**Special Projects, Automation \& Continuous Improvement**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Support special and ad\-hoc business initiatives requiring technical analysis, implementation support, testing, reporting or other Solutions Engineering expertise.
* Support Product and other stakeholders with the testing, analysis and rollout of new technical capabilities where appropriate.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation and business processes through automation and improved tooling.
* Develop, maintain or enhance automated workflows using tools such as Microsoft Power Automate where appropriate.
* Work with stakeholders to understand automation requirements and translate them into practical and supportable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency, scalability and delivery quality.
* Contribute to the continued standardisation and improvement of Solutions Engineering processes, documentation and implementation approaches.

**Qualifications \& Experience**
--------------------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Sales, implementation consulting, technical support, or a comparable client\-facing technical role, ideally within payments, fintech or financial services.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of client\-facing technical issues and implementations, and exercise sound judgement when determining when escalation is required.
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs, file\-based integrations, SFTP and/or ERP solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience using tools such as Postman, SQL, Kibana, SEQ, Jira, Confluence or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Experience within payments, fintech, banking or financial services would be advantageous.
* Experience supporting North American clients or working across US time zones would be beneficial.
* Exposure to workflow automation tools such as Microsoft Power Automate or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Ability to adapt to ad\-hoc projects, new technical requirements and changing business priorities.
* Strong organisational skills with attention to delivery timelines, quality and stakeholder communication.

**Benefits \& Perks**
---------------------

* **Leaves:** Earned, sick, casual, national holidays, maternity, paternity, bereavement, and adoption/surrogacy leave.
* **Medical \& Insurance:** Group medical coverage for self and dependents; personal accident insurance.
* **Wellness \& Health:** Wellness allowance and annual health check\-ups for self and family.
* **Tech \& Meals:** Broadband reimbursement and meal card support.
* **Commute \& Retirement:** Commuting allowance, provident fund, gratuity, voluntary provident fund, and pension.
* **Culture \& Engagement:** Support for philanthropic initiatives, fun contests, and an inclusive work environment.

**About Corpay**
================

Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. You will be responsible for designing and deploying well\-architected cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience in customer\-facing roles and a proven track record of delivering cloud solutions with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) automation on various projects. Along the way, you will:

* Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools like Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins to enable automated build and deployment processes.

* Experience supporting DR, migrations, upgrades, and modernization of SQL workloads across on\-premises, Azure, and hybrid environments, including planning, execution, and post\-migration validation.

* Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VNet, Azure Storage, Azure Functions, Azure Monitor, Azure DNS, Azure AD, Load Balancers, Traffic Manager, and Application Gateway.

* Working experience with CI/CD tools and version control systems such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Git, GitHub, or Azure Repos.

* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Azure Monitor, or AWS CloudWatch.

title: Snowflake Data Engineer
description:
Snowflake Data Engineer
Chennai, Tamil Nadu
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Developer specializing in Snowflake and SQL will be responsible for developing, and maintaining data solutions using Snowflake cloud data platform and SQL databases. The role involves optimizing data pipelines, ensuring data quality, and supporting data analytics initiatives.


Senior Data Engineer – Informatica to dbt MigrationWe are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to support a large\-scale data modernization initiative involving the migration of Informatica workflows to dbt on Snowflake. The role will be part of a factory\-based delivery model responsible for workflow analysis, code conversion, testing, reconciliation, deployment, and certification.The engineer will analyze Informatica workflows, mappings, sessions, mapplets, reusable transformations, parameter files, source\-to\-target mappings, and workflow dependencies. The role requires identifying transformation logic, business rules, lookups, joins, filters, aggregations, update strategies, pre/post SQL, scripts, and unsupported patterns that may require redesign.The engineer will convert Informatica mappings into modular and maintainable dbt models using Snowflake SQL. Responsibilities include developing staging, intermediate, and presentation\-layer models, reusable macros, incremental models, snapshots, seeds, and dbt tests. The engineer will also review and remediate code generated through automated conversion tools and ensure compliance with project coding, naming, documentation, and architecture standards.A major responsibility will be validating dbt output against the corresponding Informatica output. This includes row\-count validation, column\-level comparison, aggregate checks, null and duplicate checks, checksum validation, business\-rule validation, and reconciliation reporting. The engineer will support parallel runs, investigate data discrepancies, resolve defects, and prepare evidence required for technical and business certification.The role will also support unit testing, system integration testing, regression testing, performance testing, user acceptance testing, production deployment, smoke testing, and post\-production validation. The engineer will assist with Git\-based code management, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, deployment documentation, Control\-M or equivalent scheduling, rollback planning, and hypercare support.Candidates should have 5–10 years of data engineering or ETL experience with strong hands\-on expertise in Informatica PowerCenter, dbt, Snowflake, and advanced SQL. Experience with workflows, mappings, mapplets, parameterization, incremental processing, stored procedures, reconciliation, and ETL modernization is required. Knowledge of Git, CI/CD, Agile delivery, data quality, and performance optimization is also expected.Experience in the insurance domain, factory\-based migration programs, Control\-M, automated conversion accelerators, and Snowflake or dbt certification is preferred. The candidate should possess strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.Success will be measured through conversion productivity, first\-time\-right quality, reconciliation accuracy, low defect leakage, adherence to standards, timely certification, and stable production deployment.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Develop, and implement data solutions using snowflake and sql technologies.
  

2\. Optimize and tune snowflake data pipelines for performance and scalability.
  

3\. Collaborate with data analysts and data scientists to support data analytics projects.
  

4\. Ensure data quality and implement data governance best practices.
  

5\. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data processing and data warehousing.
  

6\. Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in snowflake and sql technologies.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Knowledge of snowflake cloud data platform and sql databases.
  

2\. Handson familiarity with designing and developing data pipelines using snowflake.
  

3\. Knowledge of writing complex sql queries and optimizing database performance.
  

4\. Familiarity with data modeling, etl processes, and data warehousing concepts.
  

5\. Knowledge of data visualization tools and data analytics platforms.
  

6\. Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
  

7\. Good communication and collaboration abilities.

1\.SnowPro Core Certification is preferred.

title: Sr. Engineering Manager
description:
Job ID
71583
Category
Ford Credit Services
Location
Chennai, India
Work Type
Hybrid

The Director of Finance Technology and Cloud Engineering will lead a portfolio of applications supporting financial reporting, expected credit loss, general ledger processing, reconciliation, disbursements, tax reporting, planning, profitability, treasury, and financial risk management.
These applications consolidate information from multiple source systems and support legal\-entity and enterprise\-level reporting across several markets. They produce financial analyses such as:
* Actual results compared with plan and forecast
* Month\-over\-month movements and explanations
* Credit loss provision movements and scenario comparisons
* Reconciliation breaks, ageing, and root\-cause analysis
* Daily cash position and liquidity checks
* Product, dealer, and customer\-segment profitability
* Interest income sensitivity and financial stress scenarios
* Forecast accuracy and reserve adequacy assessments

The application portfolio operates in a regulated financial environment and must meet applicable financial reporting, audit, security, data lineage, and internal control requirements. These include Sarbanes\-Oxley requirements, Internal Control over Financial Reporting, Current Expected Credit Loss standards, and International Financial Reporting Standard 9, where applicable.
The successful candidate will provide technology and product leadership across application development, cloud modernization, artificial intelligence adoption, major regulatory programs, and production operations. This position requires strong engineering judgment, knowledge of financial systems, experience leading managers and large technical teams, and the ability to communicate effectively with executive stakeholders.
### **Technology and product leadership**


* Own the technology strategy, product roadmap, architecture governance, and engineering delivery for a portfolio of business\-critical finance applications.
* Lead the development of new product capabilities and enhancements using modern full\-stack engineering practices, including Java, Spring Boot, application programming interfaces, microservices, Angular, and React.
* Review and approve major architecture and technical design decisions. Establish appropriate delegated approval authority for lower\-risk changes.
* Maintain strong engineering governance through design reviews, code reviews, automated testing, performance engineering, and production\-readiness assessments.
* Partner with Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Risk, and Audit stakeholders to ensure that financial calculations, reports, controls, and data lineage meet business and regulatory requirements.
* Establish controls for calculation accuracy, allocation and attribution logic, rounding and precision, recalculation, restatement, and traceability to authoritative source data.
### **Major program delivery**


* Lead technology delivery for major transformation and regulatory programs, including banking capabilities, funding initiatives, and core system modernization.
* Develop integrated delivery plans that address regulatory milestones, dependencies, data conversion, testing, operational readiness, and business adoption.
* Resolve competing priorities across financial close activities, regulatory programs, cloud modernization, security remediation, and product enhancements.
* Communicate delivery commitments, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to senior business and technology stakeholders.
### **Cloud and platform modernization**


* Define and execute the modernization roadmap for applications and databases moving to Google Cloud.
* Oversee the use of Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, Pub/Sub, Terraform, identity and access management, and workload identity capabilities.
* Lead database modernization initiatives, including the migration of Microsoft SQL Server workloads to PostgreSQL, while preserving financial results, data integrity, performance, and auditability.
* Plan production cutovers around financial close calendars. Ensure that each critical release has tested deployment, rollback, reconciliation, and business\-continuity procedures.
* Maintain supported versions of application runtimes, databases, infrastructure components, and security controls.
### **Generative AI and intelligent automation**


* Define and deliver responsible generative AI and agent\-based solutions that improve software engineering, testing, documentation, operational support, and finance processes.


* Oversee solutions involving large language models, tool\-enabled agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, and governed financial data.

title: Member of Technical Staff – MTS
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

**Role Summary:**

  

Build automation that helps athenahealth deliver reliable, high\-quality software at scale. The Member of Technical Staff – Automation Engineer will develop and maintain automated test coverage across UI, API, and backend layers, and will use Claude and Codex agents and skills to help solve testing problems such as test generation, test data creation, and failure triage. This role is based in Chennai, India and follows a hybrid work model. The person in this role will collaborate with engineers, QA partners, and other stakeholders to deliver maintainable automation solutions using modern software development and AI\-assisted testing practices. This position reports to the Senior Engineering Manager, Quality.

**Team Summary:**

  

Our Collector QA team is building new and evolving test automation capabilities for athenahealth customers. We work on solving complex quality and reliability problems for a broad set of stakeholders, including customers, internal technology\-enabled services teams, and multiple BPO vendors. Much of this work involves designing and implementing automated test coverage that validates large volumes of claim resolution workflows, with a focus on improving reliability, coverage, and release confidence.


These systems support quality validation that may be performed manually by QA partners or automated to improve overall test coverage and productivity. That means our team builds automation that exercises UI flows, validates API contracts, verifies backend data integrity, and creates a more efficient and reliable testing experience across revenue cycle operations. The engineering work often involves balancing test stability, coverage, maintainability, and evolving business needs across distributed systems.


As a Member of Technical Staff, this role contributes directly to the development of automated test coverage, API and backend automation, and Claude/Codex\-based testing agents that support these workflows. Success in this role requires solid software engineering fundamentals, exposure to test automation practices, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions. The team values clear communication, practical problem solving, and thoughtful engineering that improves quality outcomes for customers and internal users.

 **Essential Job Responsibilities:**

  

* Develop automated tests using Playwright with TypeScript to support business\-critical workflows and platform capabilities.
* Build and maintain API automation (REST/GraphQL) and backend test automation that integrate with internal platforms and dependent systems.
* Use Claude and Codex agents and skills to help solve testing problems, such as generating test cases, creating test data, and triaging test failures.
* Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate quality requirements into automated test coverage.
* Create and enhance automated tests and CI/CD test integrations that support high\-volume transactional workflows.
* Troubleshoot automation and pipeline issues, identify root causes of flaky tests and failing API contracts, and deliver fixes that improve stability.
* Contribute to code reviews, test reviews, and team engineering practices that improve automation quality and consistency.
* Support optimization of test execution performance and pipeline throughput to improve operational efficiency.
* Use AI tools, where appropriate, to improve productivity in day\-to\-day automation work, such as understanding unfamiliar code, drafting test cases, summarizing technical information, or exploring implementation options, while reviewing outputs carefully before applying them.

 **Additional Job Responsibilities:**

  

* Document automated test coverage, implementation details, and test dependencies for shared understanding across the team.
* Support deployment, release validation, and post\-release monitoring for assigned test coverage or features.
* Assist in improving CI/CD workflows and test automation practices across the team.
* Contribute to test reporting and monitoring improvements that help detect and resolve automation and production issues.
* Partner with adjacent teams to align on API contracts, integration points, and shared test dependencies.
* Share technical knowledge through walkthroughs, documentation, and collaborative problem\-solving sessions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows or reduce manual testing effort through automation enhancements.

 **Expected Education \& Experience:**

  

* 2 to 4 years of software engineering experience in test automation, backend development, or related application development work.
* Hands\-on experience with Playwright using JavaScript and TypeScript for building and maintaining automated test suites.
* Experience developing or supporting API automation (REST/GraphQL) and backend/service\-based test automation.
* Exposure to building agents and skills with Claude and Codex to solve testing problems, such as automated test generation and failure triage.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, version control, and cloud application deployment concepts (AWS or Azure).
* Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object\-oriented design, testing, debugging, and version control.
* Experience working in Agile or iterative development environments with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to analyze technical issues, communicate clearly, and contribute practical solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

 ***About athenahealth***

***Our vision:*** *In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*

***Our company culture:*** *Our talented* *employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do\-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission\-driven problem\-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award\-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.*

***Our DEI commitment:*** *Our vision of accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.*

***What we can do for you:***

*Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative* *workspaces* — *some offices even welcome dogs.*

*We also encourage a better work\-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in\-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,* *full\-time. Join our global team for a career filled with opportunities to solve challenges both small and large, local and global, simple and complex.

**Wilhelmsen Ship Management** is a third\-party ship manager providing a wide range of maritime services worldwide. With a strong workforce of shore\-based employees and seafarers, we operate one of the world's largest maritime networks across more than 70 countries.

 **Wilhelmsen Ship Management Chennai** is looking for a **Technical Support Engineer (PMS)** to join the **Global PMS Support Team**. This role combines Planned Maintenance System (PMS) technical support and PMS database project activities, requiring close interaction with vessel personnel, Technical Managers, Fleet Managers, and other stakeholders.


The successful candidate will be responsible for providing PMS support to vessels, maintaining PMS technical data, supporting database improvement initiatives, and ensuring accuracy and quality of PMS spare parts data. The role requires excellent communication skills, strong customer service orientation, and the ability to work effectively with both vessel and shore\-based stakeholders.

 **Main Responsibilities**

* Provide first\-line technical support for the Planned Maintenance System (PMS), responding to vessel and stakeholder queries in a timely and professional manner.
* Liaise with vessel crews, Technical Managers, Fleet Managers, and other stakeholders to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve PMS\-related issues.
* Maintain and update PMS databases, including equipment hierarchies, maintenance tasks, spare parts records, and technical documentation in accordance with company standards.
* Review maker's manuals, drawings, and technical documents to extract, validate, and standardize spare parts, component, and maintenance information.
* Perform quality assurance and data validation activities to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of PMS data.
* Support PMS database Projects, migration, standardization, and continuous improvement across the fleet.
* Execute bulk data updates, cleaning, and verification activities to maintain high data quality standards.
* Prepare reports, analyze PMS data, and provide insights using Microsoft Excel and other reporting tools.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives and special PMS\-related projects.
* Deliver a high level of customer service while supporting vessels and internal stakeholders.
* Support team objectives and undertake additional responsibilities assigned by the Team Lead.

 **Qualifications \& Experience**

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in marine engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in PMS support, maintenance planning, PMS database building, or related technical functions.
* Experience in PMS data management and technical support for vessels or maritime operations is preferred.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, filtering, data analysis, and reporting.
* Basic knowledge of SQL is desirable.
* Good understanding of vessel equipment, maintenance practices, and technical documentation.
* Experience in spare parts extraction, data standardization, and quality assurance activities.
* Knowledge of PMS component structure and maintenance job extraction from maker's manuals is an advantage.
* Previous onboard sailing experience will be considered an added benefit.

 **Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Effective stakeholder management and customer service orientation.
* High attention to detail with a focus on quality and accuracy.
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and results\-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.

***(****A brief overview of the role, its purpose, and key responsibilities.**)*  

Own the on\-site implementation and operationalization of DPDP / DPDPA privacy capabilities, combining privacy\-domain knowledge with hands\-on technology deployment, integration, workflow automation and troubleshooting.


Act as the primary technical bridge among the customer, Privacy / Legal, Information Security, IT, Seqrite implementation teams and product engineering.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Interpret DPDP / DPDPA and relevant GDPR requirements; conduct current\-state assessments, privacy control gap analysis, data\-flow discovery and requirement traceability.


* Translate privacy requirements into solution architecture, configuration specifications, implementation plans and acceptance criteria; support DPIA / PIA, RoPA, evidence collection and audit readiness.


* Install, configure, harden, upgrade and maintain privacy technology across development, test, staging and production environments.


* Configure data discovery, classification, inventory, mapping, consent / notice management, rights\-request fulfilment, retention and deletion workflows.


* Integrate privacy platforms with databases, file repositories, SaaS applications, identity providers, email, ticketing, SIEM, DLP and enterprise portals; execute SIT, UAT, security testing, cutover and rollback.


* Develop secure APIs, connectors, adapters, scripts, workflow extensions, validation rules, reports and automation; perform code reviews, testing, secure coding and release packaging.


* Troubleshoot application, API, database, authentication and deployment issues; perform RCA and implement sustainable fixes.


* Own customer\-site coordination, progress / risk reporting, product\-engineering escalations, administrator training, SOPs, runbooks, documentation, audits and critical incidents within agreed SLAs.

  

  

**Must Have Skills**
  

*(The essential skills and expertise required to succeed in this role.)*  

* 4\-5 years of relevant experience in privacy engineering, privacy technology, data protection implementation, GRC technology or enterprise application integration.


* Practical exposure to GDPR and India DPDPA / DPDP, including privacy principles, consent, data\-principal rights, data inventory, retention and audit evidence.


* Hands\-on implementation experience with privacy, data governance, data discovery, consent, DSAR, DLP or compliance automation platforms.


* Hands\-on coding / scripting capability for APIs, connectors, automation jobs, reports and integration utilities.


* Working knowledge of REST / JSON APIs, OAuth 2\.0, SAML, OpenID Connect, webhooks, SDKs, ETL patterns and enterprise integration troubleshooting.


* Working knowledge of SQL and enterprise databases such as Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL or MySQL.


* Exposure to cloud / container fundamentals, IAM / PAM, DLP, SIEM, SOAR, EDR / XDR, encryption, vulnerability management and monitoring tools.


* Windows Server and Linux administration, certificates, proxies, DNS, firewalls, service accounts and log analysis.


* Secure SDLC, OWASP principles, secrets management, audit logging, unit / integration testing, API testing and technical documentation.


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering or equivalent; strong written and verbal communication.

  

  

**Nice / Good to have skills**
*(Additional skills that are not mandatory but give you an added advantage in this role.)*  

* CIPP/E and CIPT certifications; CIPM, CDPSE, ISO/IEC 27701 or ISO/IEC 27001 are preferred.


* Experience with Python, Java, C\#/.NET, JavaScript / TypeScript, PowerShell or shell scripting.


* Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS or GCP, Docker / Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD, release automation and rollback planning.


* Power BI or equivalent dashboards, advanced Excel, operational metrics, audit evidence and executive status reporting.


* Customer\-site implementation experience with strong stakeholder coordination, documentation, knowledge transfer and structured RCA.

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.


As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.


**About Energy Systems**  

  

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
### **About the role**


The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production\-grade software products and shared platform capabilities within DNV’s Digital \& Transformation organization. This role sits within the Application Engineering section and contributes to the development and modernization of scalable web applications that support digital delivery across Energy Systems.


This role helps to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification \& Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.  

  



This is not a project\-based delivery or staff\-augmentation role. Engineers are expected to develop deep product knowledge and remain accountable for the quality, maintainability, and operation of the software they build.
  

Working in close partnership with Frontend Engineers, Product leadership, Data \& AI Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and Platform Security \& Compliance, this role helps bring application capabilities, data services, AI\-enabled features, workflows, and APIs into one cohesive platform and product experience.
  

The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports scalable software across a modern Microsoft\-oriented full\-stack environment. The primary stack includes C\# and .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, MySQL, Redis, TypeScript, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Docker, .NET Aspire, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Azure DevOps. description:
